theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tpf_blowUp_domain_eventually
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → (∀ i, 0 < lams i) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), Bornology.IsBounded K → ∀ᶠ i in atTop, K ⊆ dilation x (lams i) '' U
